rows.note: Use this when discussing a recurring or conventional combination of words in a language.

example.english: This collocation is very common, so you should definitely note it down when learning English.
example.traditional: 呢個詞語搭配好常見，學英文一定要記低。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ci4 jyu5 daap3 pui3 hou2 soeng4 gin3 hok6 jing1 man4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gei3 dai1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a general combination or juxtaposition of things, including words or sounds.

example.english: The collocation of these two colours looks pretty good.
example.traditional: 呢兩隻色嘅配搭幾好睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zek3 sik1 ge3 pui3 daap3 gei2 hou2 tai2
